rationale: The short thesis remains intact as TRMD continues to trade near the bottom of its daily range (16.9%) and holds firmly below both the descending session VWAP ($32.50) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($32.29). After previously breaking the $32.23 level to establish a new low at $31.99, the recent low-volume consolidation just below the 5-minute 9-EMA indicates weak buying interest rather than a reversal. With the broader market down (SPY -0.40%) and price respecting overhead resistance, holding for a retest of the session lows and the $31.82 target is justified.
